_classes.name: actor_raw stored as the passive sentence subject (costs, application) instead of the acting body
effective date unparsed because raw_clause captured a proviso or schedule instead of the 'shall take effect' sentence
_classes.rule: effective_dates[law].effective_date is None and 'take effect' not in raw_clause (laws); records with effective_date None
_classes.note: 262 laws and 270 records have effective_date null overall; 25 laws match the narrower rule

_classes.name: NYC Administrative Code duty resolved to bare 'New York City' instead of the administering NYC agency
_classes.rule: agency == 'New York City' and 'Administrative Code' in citation (broader: agency == 'New York City', 143)

_classes.name: extends_existing false on a 'Provided, further' proviso that widens an existing authority
_classes.rule: extends_existing is False and re.match(r'(?i)^provided,? (further|however)', quote)

_classes.name: joint grant to a locality and a named district/body stored as one record (second holder missing)
_classes.rule: re.search(r'(?i)\b(town|city|village|county)\b.* and the .*\b(district|authority|agency|corporation)\b', actor_raw) and only one record in the law with that quote

_classes.name: record created from new matter that only adds a condition (an extra approver) to an unchanged power
_classes.rule: proxy: extends_existing and re.search(r'(?i)upon (the )?approval (by|of)', quote); confirm by hand

_classes.name: sunset/application-window extension and mirrored RPTL provision missed
_classes.rule: packet LAW TEXT matches r'(?:two thousand|nineteen hundred)\s*\[[a-z\- ]+\]\s*\{\{[a-z\- ]+' (year word replaced) and the law has zero extends_existing records; heuristic, overcounts laws where the year change is not an authority
